item.title: 161 Willesden Lane, 8th August
item.description:
I write to request installation of pedestrian traffic lights. I walk in the area and I pass by this road around 3-4 times per week. I note that pedestrian traffic lights are not available which may cause potential dangers towards the drivers and pedestrians. When the pedestrians need to cross the road, they need to rely upon the drivers' light indicators to make the decision. But recently, when I was walking on this road in an afternoon, I realised the sunlight hindered me from observing the driver's light indicator. As a result, both the driver and I had to stop quickly to prevent an accident happening. I would be grateful if pedestrian traffic lights can be installed to assist pedestrian users. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 162, Willesden Lane, Brondesbury, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
